# Each take-over makes the slot the home of the gamepad that pressed.
@0 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 1 "Pad A" key=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 provisional
@30 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 1 "Pad A" key=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 confirmed
@100 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 2 "Pad B" key=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 provisional handoff
@200 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 3 "Pad C" key=030000000c0000000c00000000000000 home=030000000c0000000c00000000000000 handoff takeover
@400 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 2 "Pad B" key=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 home=030000000c0000000c00000000000000 provisional handoff
@550 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 4 "Pad A" key=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 reconnected handoff takeover
